title: Real Property Disclosure Statement
description: Alabama Code §6-5-258 requires sellers of residential real property to provide a written disclosure statement covering known material defects in the property. Sellers must disclose conditions affecting the structural integrity, roof, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and environmental hazards.

required_actions.note: Disclosure must be provided before execution of the purchase agreement.

title: Agency Disclosure Under Consumer's Agency and Disclosure Act
description: The Alabama Real Estate Consumer's Agency and Disclosure Act (Ala. Code §34-27-80 et seq.) requires licensees to disclose their agency relationship to all parties at the first substantive contact. Dual agency is permitted only with written informed consent of both parties.

required_actions.note: Must be disclosed at first substantive contact with each party.

title: Title Company Closing State
description: Alabama is a title company closing state. Closings are typically conducted by title companies or closing attorneys, but attorney presence is not required by statute. Title insurance is standard practice.

required_actions.note: Attorney closing optional but common in some counties.

title: Wood-Destroying Organism Inspection Report
description: Alabama lenders and standard practice require a wood-destroying organism (WDO) inspection report (NPMA-33 form) for most residential transactions, particularly when financing is involved. The Alabama Department of Agriculture and Industries regulates pest control operators who issue these reports.

required_actions.note: Inspection must be performed by a licensed pest control operator within 30 days of closing.

title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure (Pre-1978 Properties)
description: Federal law (42 U.S.C. §4852d) requires sellers of properties built before 1978 to disclose known lead-based paint hazards and provide EPA pamphlet 'Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home.' Buyer receives 10-day inspection period.

required_actions.note: Buyer has 10-day right to conduct lead inspection (waivable).
